description: This file defines template classes and functions for managing plugin interfaces within the WPEFramework, including reference management, interface creation, and configuration via a builder pattern.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceRef
classes.description: A smart reference wrapper for plugin interface pointers, managing lifetime and providing move semantics.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating plugin interface instances with customizable parameters.

methods.name: createInterface
methods.description: Creates and returns a plugin interface instance using the provided builder.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: A utility function to create a std::unique_ptr for a given type with forwarded arguments.
